items.title: The kernel of a surjection onto a module of finite presentation is of finite type, locally on a ringed space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows, for a module of finite presentation on a ringed space, that the kernel of a surjection from a finite free module and the kernel of a surjection from any module of finite type are again of finite type (author lemma at source lines 1673-1683, label lemma-kernel-surjection-finite-free-onto-finite-presentation). The proof (source lines 1685-1721) works locally with a presentation of the module, lifts the generators along the given surjection, uses the presentation map in the reverse direction to build the map (\beta \circ \chi, 1 - \beta \circ \alpha) which surjects onto the kernel (proof lines 1708-1714), and then reduces the second assertion to the first by factoring through a finite free module. The explicit surjection onto the kernel is the content. H2.
